headline: Vanguard lead the conference with a losing record
dek: Vanguard top the conference table though they have lost seven matches across the season and won six. Westmont, whose only conference defeat came at Vanguard on the day conference play opened, have a match in hand on them.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Kyle Denn has scored thirteen of Biola's twenty-five goals, more than half of everything his side has scored.

wire.line: Hawai'i Pacific have drawn level on points with Vanguard at the top of the table.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Twelve matches dated in August still carry no published result, the earliest of them Vanguard's on the season's first day.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Concordia Irvine have now won eight matches, level with Point Loma and more than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Jessup have conceded forty-eight goals, more than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Chaminade have lost twelve matches and drawn two, scoring seven goals and conceding thirty-one.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Aidan Strickler has made forty-six saves for Westmont and conceded twenty-four goals, a save percentage of .657.

last_match.line: Hawai'i Pacific have not lost since Westmont won on their ground; Jessup are still without a conference win.

next_match.line: Biola have lost back-to-back home matches; a Vanguard win would take them clear of Hawai'i Pacific at the top.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
